about.p1: Hi, I'm a frontend developer with 2+ years of commercial experience.
about.p2: I build fast, accessible and responsive interfaces.
about.p3: 🎓 I don't have a formal IT degree - everything I know comes from self-study, online courses, and practice. I truly believe that passion and curiosity matter more than a diploma.
about.cats: Outside of work, I'm a proud cat mom of two and a passionate traveler with over 50 countries visited ✈️🌍
